text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Summer training camp. Naturally,
I end up spending
far more time with Still in Love than usual,
but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...I feel someone watching me.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: I'm just... looking at you, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still in Love simply smiles as always,
answering as if it were the most natural
thing in the world.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(...Do you not do well in the heat?
You're... sweating so much...)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(It must be draining your stamina, too...
Yet your expression never changes,
smiling as you watch over my training.)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(Are you good at swimming? Bad at it?
...Either is fine with me.
As long as I can be by your side,
even a sandy beach is—...Ah, a wave.)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(...Fufu, you jumped.
Did the sand brushing your feet tickle?)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(You're staring at a fallen seashell...
Do you like it?
Or are you worried someone might step on it
and get hurt?)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(...Ah.
You're walking ahead along the path I'm to
take.
Checking the footing, step by slow step.)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(—You look up at the sky so often.
In the morning, the evening,
and at night.)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(What color is your favorite sky,
I wonder?
...I want to know.
I want to know so badly.)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(I wanted to accept everything about you,
so I was looking for the parts you might
want to hide, but—)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...All I find are precious,
adorable sides of you...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(Trainer...
Getting to know you makes me so happy.
So, so happy...)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: (—...And yet.)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...More...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...—I want moooore...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her voice,
belonging to her and not "that girl," does
not ring with madness.
It merely dissolves quietly into the sound
of the waves.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Every time our eyes meet,
Still in Love smiles with joy.
Curious about what her glances mean,
I decide to ask her.
choice_data_list: Is there... something you'd like t...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sorry. Look at me...
I was staring far too much... It bothered you,
didn't it...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still in Love flusters, shifting her gaze
as if trying to gauge my reaction.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Then, as if making up her mind,
she begins to speak.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
............
...Remember...
how I said before that I wanted to change
myself?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...I thought... that the way I act,
the way I am...
might be becoming a burden to you,
Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Yet you made me feel...
that I'm fine just the way I am. So,
at the very least...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To put it simply—she seemed to be wishing
that I would place the same kind of burden
on her in return.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I've never once considered her a burden,
but her feelings are what matter.
If doing this can put her heart at ease—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Where... are we?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I lead Still in Love to a spot a little ways
away
from the camp lodge.
There lies a small clearing surrounded by
trees.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A sea of stars that you could never see in
the city. Thanks to being away
from the camp buildings and other lights,
only starlight floats in the sky.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...It's beautiful...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I was completely captivated for a moment,
but...
Um, is this starry sky... your... uhm...
choice_data_list: Whenever I find a beautiful place,...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Not just places,
either. Whenever I find something nice,
I always want to share it with Still in
Love.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Fun things, unusual things.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I want to take in the same sights together,
eat delicious food together;
I find myself thinking that,
and sometimes I even end up calling out to
her on impulse.
choice_data_list: Even though you need to focus on r...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that a heavy burden on you? I ask.
Still in Love looks at me in sheer disbelief,
and then—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
You... you were thinking about that...
all along...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In an instant,
warmth rushes into her eyes.
For a moment I think it might be "that girl,"
but it isn't.
She weaves her words remaining entirely
herself.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...I don't mind.
If it is you calling for me,
then that must surely... be time that I need,
as well...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: So please, call for me.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Anytime, anywhere,
whatever the occasion may be—
call for Still in Love.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her spellbinding tone leaves me flustered.
Unaware of my confusion,
she simply giggles softly.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Besides... fufu.
Things like this aren't a burden at all.
choice_data_list: I feel the exact same way.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Is that so?
Well then... I suppose it can't be helped.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: They truly are... gorgeous stars.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I look up at the starry sky once more.
Dazzled by that overwhelming light,
I fail to notice her crimson gaze fixed upon
my profile—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(Such a kind person... Please,
do not hide anything. I want to know more.
Every single part of you,
down to your deepest depths...)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(Even if...
I am reviled as shameless for it.)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
Shall we head back soon?
choice_data_list: Yeah, the road at night can be dan...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Yes... But I am not afraid.
As long as I am with you,
no matter what path it may be...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...—So please, do not be afraid either.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Someday,
will you...
bare even more of yourself to me?
